description: This PHP script handles the submission of survey responses within the SuiteCRM platform. It validates input parameters, loads survey and contact data, processes user responses to survey questions, saves the responses to the database, and redirects to a thank you page or shows a 404 error if appropriate.

methods.name: getCampaignIdFromTracker
methods.description: Retrieves the campaign ID associated with a given tracker ID from the campaign_log table.

methods.name: processSurvey
methods.description: Processes and saves survey responses based on user input and survey question types, then redirects to a thank-you page.

methods.name: do404
methods.description: Outputs a 404 Not Found message and terminates execution.
